subtitle: Sovereign Experience Engine — New Home, Navigation & Personalization
changes: Rebuilt the companion home entrance with a cinematic Assassin Dominion welcome, clear starting actions, curated tool destinations and preserved original overview counts.
Introduced a Continue Where You Left Off section using website navigation recents and read-only existing Command Launcher pinned tools.
Organized all existing studios into five collapsible desktop navigation groups, preserving individual tool buttons, the mobile All Tools menu and search behavior.
Added website-level Appearance Settings for gold, violet and cyan accents, background visibility, comfortable/compact navigation, higher contrast and reduced visual motion.
Added an Update Center in the website header with verified published companion version, release highlights, recent release history and a mark-as-read indicator.
Improved responsive layout, touch targets, keyboard dialog navigation and reduced-motion handling for iPhone and desktop, without redesigning underlying studios.
Separated the original Overview hero from the main studio experience while preserving its working metrics and existing local-planning content.
Preserved Battle.net sign-in, Cloudflare Worker, all existing studio code and player storage keys; added a website-shell isolation regression test and maintained Discord release metadata.
